name: Scripting Slackers VR
summary:
Back in the day, I almost called myself The Scripting Slacker, mostly because I slept through just about all of my intro to game dev classes. But time passed, the vision sharpened, and the name Doubt Not was born.

This is the remastered version of the very first game I ever published (Scripting Slackers Origin). A chaotic, pop culture packed platformer built to test patience and inflict glorious suffering. What started as a simple side scroller quickly turned into a brutal challenge for all but its creator
